description:
Each design document in the active area that carries no issue prefix is recorded against the outcome this plan decides for it, so no file is left undecided and no worker has to judge one.

## Background

Each file's outcome is decided rather than open: 8 take the archived location an owning container's run produces; 1 is claimed by a terminal owner outside every archived subtree, so the runs mirror it into the archive and retain the source. Recording is therefore an application of a decided mapping and needs no judgement about an individual file.

The disposition record is `disposition-design-documents.md` inside this epic's canonical artifact directory, `dev/archive/8e071e18-dev-artifact-layout/active/8e071e18-dev-artifact-layout`. The record's directory is the canonical artifact directory the command resolves for this epic in the active area rather than a path composed by hand, which makes this epic one of the convention's first consumers. Keeping the record in one document rather than inside each file leaves the historical documents' bytes untouched, for the same reason archival warns about in-content citations instead of rewriting them.

The mapping is:

- `dev/active/agent-validation-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/4a00b2b0-agent-validation/active/agent-validation-design.md`
- `dev/active/ci-gate-integration-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/14303b30-phase5-2/active/ci-gate-integration-design.md`
- `dev/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md` — mirrored to `dev/archive/2d109173-docs-exhaustive-audit/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/6eb585bc-core-maintenance/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/9ac9fdac-graph-templates/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/f2532a2d-jit-project-lead/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/2fbd2a82-planning-bracket/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/2e926e39-agent-seamlessness/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/71373e37-docs-lifecycle/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, `dev/archive/cfb3ba94-docs/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md`, with the source retained at `dev/active/documentation-lifecycle-design.md` because a terminal owner sits outside every archived subtree
- `dev/active/documentation-lifecycle-phase2-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/94f873c8-docs-lifecycle-p2/active/documentation-lifecycle-phase2-design.md`
- `dev/active/observability-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/d7bfd4a4-observability/active/observability-design.md`
- `dev/active/planning-bracket-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/2fbd2a82-planning-bracket/active/planning-bracket-design.md`
- `dev/active/production-polish-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/9d427a6b-production-polish/active/production-polish-design.md`
- `dev/active/production-stability-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/5fe00921-production-stability/active/production-stability-design.md`
- `dev/active/rejection-state-design.md` — archived location `dev/archive/93f3e4df-rejection-state/active/rejection-state-design.md`

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The record at `dev/archive/8e071e18-dev-artifact-layout/active/8e071e18-dev-artifact-layout/disposition-design-documents.md` lists every file in the set with exactly one disposition of the three kinds.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every file recorded with an archived location is present at that location and absent from the active area.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every file recorded as mirrored is present at each mirrored location and retained at its source path.
- [hard] REQ-04: No file in the set is left without a recorded disposition.
- [hard] REQ-05: No file in the set has its own content edited to carry its disposition.
- [hard] REQ-06: Whole-repository validation passes afterwards.
